question: Should OpenClaw ship agent-authored custom dashboard widgets as an enabled-by-default bundled plugin surface with an unauthenticated static asset route and prompt-capable browser bridge?
rationale: The plugin boundary is technically plausible, but accepting this permanent bundled product, persistence model, and browser trust boundary requires explicit maintainer intent after the blocking defects are fixed.

options.title: Ship the full bundled surface
options.body: Accept Workspaces and custom widgets after all findings, exact-head proof, security review, and upgrade review are cleared.

options.title: Land trusted workspaces only
options.body: Ship SQLite workspaces, built-in widgets, CLI, and agent tools while deferring custom executable widgets and their unauthenticated route.

options.title: Keep it external
options.body: Move the capability to an optional external plugin if core maintainers do not want to own this permanent product and security surface.

recommendation.title: Ship the full bundled surface
recommendation.body: Accept Workspaces and custom widgets after all findings, exact-head proof, security review, and upgrade review are cleared.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history shows this person introduced the bundled plugin-view seam being expanded and is the strongest available owner for the product-boundary decision.
